findings.title: deleteMany OR branch deletes reminders of all methods, not just SMS
findings.body: The new OR branch `{ retryCount: { gt: 1 } }` has no `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` constraint, so this SMS-only cron will delete EMAIL and WHATSAPP WorkflowReminder rows whenever their retryCount exceeds 1. Since retryCount is a shared column that other schedulers may also increment in the future (and the field is generic), this can silently destroy pending email/WhatsApp reminders. Add the method filter inside the OR branch.

findings.title: Failure paths that never increment retryCount keep retrying forever
findings.body: retryCount is only incremented when `twilio.scheduleSMS` returns falsy or throws. If `message` is empty/null or `sendTo` is missing (e.g. attendee without a phone number), the `if (message?.length ... && sendTo)` block is skipped entirely, the reminder stays `scheduled: false`, and the cron will keep picking it up every run until the scheduledDate passes — exactly the behaviour this PR intends to stop. Increment retryCount (or mark it) in that else case too.

findings.title: deleteMany on retryCount has no supporting index
findings.body: The new delete condition filters on `retryCount > 1` with no method/scheduledDate constraint and there is no index covering retryCount, so each cron run forces a full scan of WorkflowReminder (a high-volume table). Consider restricting the predicate to SMS + existing indexed columns or adding an appropriate index.
